delivered.body: Executive Employment Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. and the Executive. 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer. 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 2,500,000, payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, plus benefits made generally available to senior executives. The Executive shall also be eligible for an annual performance bonus with a target equal to 100% of Base Salary, subject to achievement of performance objectives established in good faith and communicated in writing at the beginning of each performance year. 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive, subject to execution and non-revocation of a customary release, (a) an amount equal to two times the sum of Base Salary and target annual bonus, payable in substantially equal installments over 24 months, and (b) continued health benefits for up to 24 months, subject to applicable law and the terms of the applicable plans. “Cause” and “Good Reason” shall be defined in the definitive agreement. 4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not compete for twelve months after departure.
